SELECT o.id, o.company_id, o.no, o.status, o.order_type, o.brand, o.contract_no, o.order_date, o.required_date, o.commit_date, o.currency, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.sales_id, o.merch_id, c.short_name AS company_name, o.source, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.version, COALESCE(agg.scheduled_qty, 0) AS scheduled_qty, COALESCE(agg.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty FROM ord_order o JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = o.company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(i.scheduled_qty) AS scheduled_qty, SUM(i.returned_qty) AS returned_qty FROM ord_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) agg ON true
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.no DESC

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ord_order o
GROUP BY o.status

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.no, o.status, o.order_type, o.brand, agg.qty, agg.tech_pack_version, o.required_date, o.commit_date, o.merch_id FROM ord_order o JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(i.qty) AS qty, MAX(p.version) AS tech_pack_version FROM ord_order_item i LEFT JOIN tp_tech_pack p ON p.id = i.tech_pack_id WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.style_id = #{styleId}) agg ON true WHERE agg.qty > 0 AND (o.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR o.sales_id = #{scope.userId} OR o.merch_id = #{scope.userId}) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.no DESC
